Specialized in card payment processing, issuer/acquirer systems, POS & eCommerce integrations, PCI- DSS compliance, EMV, tokenization, and ISO 8583 banking protocols.
Currently driving delivery excellence at AurusTech, overseeing multi-million-dollar payment programs for Fortune 500 retailers and financial institutions. Proven track record in delivering bank-grade, highly available, secure transaction systems aligned with the standards of leading banks such as JPMC, Citi, HSBC, Barclays, and Deutsche Bank.

raw_sections.certifications:
CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) • Agile Project Manager (ICP-APM) • PCI-DSS Compliance & EMV Fundamentals (Internal Training) • Generative AI Overview for Project Managers
TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY STACK
Payments: EMV, NFC, DUKPT, Tokenization, ISO 8583, HSM, PEDs Frameworks: Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall Tools: Jira, Confluence, QC, Basecamp, PPM Platforms: Windows, Linux, Ubuntu, CentOSS
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS
Promoted to Delivery Manager for consistent high-quality delivery across payment programs. • Awarded Star Performer for delivering a global retail payment transformation under budget and ahead of schedule. Led multi-brand POS and eCommerce payment rollouts across 5000+ stores.
• Orchestrated a multi-tender acceptance platform including credit, debit, gift cards, crypto wallets, ApplePay, GooglePay.
Resolved long-standing PED–POS integration issues across major retail chains through optimized
infrastructure and device strategy.
PROJECT DETAILS
Delivered solutions across Health, Apparel, Grocery, Auto, C-Store, Lifestyle, Specialty Retail including:
National EMV upgrade programs, contactless enablement & M400 deployments. • eCommerce payment gateway onboarding with tokenized cards, digital wallets & 3DS flows. • Reconciliation & settlement APIs for Chase and other processors. • PINless debit implementation and multi-processor certification (Fiserv). • POS–PED mapping strategy redesign to eliminate IP-mismatch-driven outages. • Multi-brand digital payment onboarding for new eCommerce storefronts. • Youth & Lifestyle Retail – Delivered PINless debit support and coordinated certifications with Fiserv and store QA teams. Supported eCommerce payments testing including PINless fallback and ApplePay token validation in staging and production.
Apparel & Retail – Led support for post-release issues including POS-PED integration validation, PED version upgrades, and transaction communication recovery in coordination with the client's network team. Also supported QA and rollout of digital transaction flow via web-based test harness and token-based payments.
